title: NVIDIA Parakeet-unified-en-0.6b Unified ASR Model
summary: A 600-million parameter Automatic Speech Recognition model that unifies offline batch processing and real-time streaming transcription. It utilizes the Unified-FastConformer-RNNT architecture to deliver high accuracy and low latency across diverse audio tasks.
research_notes: Achieves real-time factors up to 3000x on H100 GPUs with latencies as low as 160ms; features native punctuation and capitalization support.

evolution.summary: Unified the previously separate TDT offline and specialized streaming architectures into a single model capable of dynamic switching. It follows the Parakeet-TDT-0.6b series, offering significantly improved WER and deployment efficiency.
